commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
WORK="$(mktemp -d /tmp/bloomml-wur-qc.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
export WORK
git clone --quiet --depth 1 --single-branch --branch research/simulator-fidelity-kaggle-20261103 https://github.com/MichalMatu/bloomml.git "$WORK/source"
test "$(git -C "$WORK/source" rev-parse HEAD)" = 06b901f2b54d3e967756fb45c2a3cec7a6be3b5b
cd "$WORK/source"
python3 -m unittest -q tests.test_wur_external_benchmark tests.test_wur_forecast_probe
echo "WUR_EXACT_SOURCE_TESTS|PASS_16_OF_16"
kaggle datasets download -d piantic/autonomous-greenhouse-challengeagc-2nd-2019 -p "$WORK" >/dev/null
ARCHIVE="$(find "$WORK" -maxdepth 1 -name '*.zip' -print -quit)"
python3 -m tools.ml.wur_external_benchmark --zip "$ARCHIVE" --output "$WORK/qa.json"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os,json
j=json.loads((Path(os.environ['WORK'])/'qa.json').read_text())
assert j['total_climate_rows']==286854
print('WUR_DATASET_QC_SHA|'+j['mirror_sha256'])
for row in j['sites']:
 print('WUR_QC_SITE|'+json.dumps({'name':row['site'],'extreme':row['extreme_physical_review_counts'],'invalid':row['invalid_numeric_values'],'warnings':row['warnings']},ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':')))
print('WUR_QC_REAL_DATA|PASS_WITH_WARNINGS')
PY
